name: uae-compliance-2026
display_name: UAE Compliance 2026 — FDL 10/2025 + CR 134/2025, DIFC, ADGM, VARA, PDPL
description: Structured knowledge graph for the UAE's multi-regulator financial-compliance architecture as of 2026: Federal Decree-Law 10/2025 (in force 14 Oct 2025) + Cabinet Resolution 134/2025 (executive regulations) replacing FDL 20/2018 as the federal AML/CTF/PF statute; CBUAE Payment Token Services Regulation 2024 (stablecoin + payment token licensing); SCA crypto-asset framework; DFSA (DIFC common-law financial regulator) + ADGM FSRA Digital Asset framework (amended 10 June 2025 — privacy-token + algorithmic-stablecoin prohibitions); VARA Rulebooks (Dubai-level VASP licensing); Federal Decree-Law 45/2021 (UAE PDPL) + DIFC DP Law 5/2020 + ADGM Data Protection Regulations 2021; Federal Penal Code anti-bribery; Federal Competition Law 36/2023; Federal Decree-Law 33/2021 (Labour); Federal Decree-Law 48/2023 (Insurance Regulation, post-merger of IA into CBUAE).
author: Futurechain FCP Team
jurisdiction: United Arab Emirates (Federal + DIFC + ADGM + Dubai/VARA)
regulation_ids: ADGM FSRA Rulebook + Digital Asset Framework (amended 10 Jun 2025)
